description: Dialog (a core TmModal) for configuring and triggering a Gantt export: format tiles (PDF, PNG, Excel, MS Project XML) as a radio group, the options that apply to the chosen format (paper, orientation, critical path, today line, workload, zoom for PDF/PNG; the columns for Excel) and a preview area.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Fires when the dialog should close.

parameters.name: PreviewContent
parameters.description: Content of the preview area. When null (default) the area shows the neutral "Preview" placeholder; a host that renders its own preview supplies it here.

parameters.name: OnExport
parameters.description: Fires when the user confirms export with the chosen options.
